# busy-office-ui v0.3.0

> CSS-first UI framework for ERP and back-office applications. Semantic components,
> density as a dimension (data-density="compact|comfortable|spacious" on <html> or any
> wrapper), dark mode via [data-theme="dark"], all framework CSS in @layer (unlayered
> consumer CSS always wins). Browser floor: Chrome/Edge 119 · Firefox 129 · Safari 17.5.

## Install

npm i @busy-office/ui
import "@busy-office/ui/css";                      # all-in-one
# a la carte, ORDER MATTERS: tokens -> reset -> components
import "@busy-office/ui/css/tokens"; import "@busy-office/ui/css/reset";
import "@busy-office/ui/css/components/data-table";

## JS behaviors (call each ONCE — document delegation survives all DOM swaps)

import { initDialogs, initDataTables, initTabs, initDropdowns, initAlerts,
         refreshDataTable, trapFocus } from "@busy-office/ui/js";
- initDialogs(): REQUIRED for <dialog class="bo-dialog"> + [data-dialog-trigger].
- initDataTables(): select-all, live "n selected" count, O(1) toolbar reveal;
  re-derives on htmx:afterSwap; refreshDataTable(container) for other swaps.
- initTabs(): REQUIRED for tabs (roving tabindex, RTL-aware arrows).
- initDropdowns(): anchors [popover] menus to their invoker; close-on-select.
- initAlerts(): .bo-alert__dismiss removes its alert/toast.

## Behavior hooks (generated — the DOM each init reads)
- initDialogs(): Dialog behavior via event delegation — no per-element binding, no DOM flags [hooks: data-dialog-trigger data-dismissible data-state]
- initDataTables(): Optional table behavior (~1 kB): wires select-all, keeps an O(1) data-any-selected attribute on the container (so CSS needn't re-scan every row via :has() on large grids), and maintains a live "n… [hooks: bo-data-table-container bo-data-table__row-select bo-data-table__select-all bo-data-table__selection-count data-any-selected data-selected-count-override]
- refreshDataTable(): Optional table behavior (~1 kB): wires select-all, keeps an O(1) data-any-selected attribute on the container (so CSS needn't re-scan every row via :has() on large grids), and maintains a live "n… [hooks: bo-data-table-container bo-data-table__row-select bo-data-table__select-all bo-data-table__selection-count data-any-selected data-selected-count-override]
- initDataGrid(): Opt-in ARIA grid pattern for .bo-data-table (WAI-ARIA APG "Grid", the interactive-widgets variant) [hooks: bo-data-table bo-data-table-container bo-data-table__row-select data-grid-nav]
- refreshDataGrid(): Opt-in ARIA grid pattern for .bo-data-table (WAI-ARIA APG "Grid", the interactive-widgets variant) [hooks: bo-data-table bo-data-table-container bo-data-table__row-select data-grid-nav]
- initRowEdit(): Multi-row inline edit: tracks which rows have unsaved changes, shows a per-row Save/Cancel affordance, and dispatches a `bo:row-save` event for your code to persist (fetch, hx-patch, form submit —… [hooks: bo-badge bo-badge--warning bo-btn bo-btn--sm bo-data-table bo-data-table__row-edit-actions bo-input bo-input--seamless data-row-edit data-row-edit-cancel data-row-edit-dirty data-row-edit-save data-row-id data-row-state]
- initTableToolbar(): Optional data-table toolbar actions: column visibility + export [hooks: bo-btn bo-btn--secondary bo-checkbox bo-data-table bo-data-table-container bo-data-table__toolbar bo-dropdown__menu data-col data-col-toggle data-multiselect data-multiselect-label data-table-export data-table-export-format]
- initStickyCols(): Multiple frozen columns (roadmap 72.1) — opt-in via [data-sticky-cols], "2" | "3" only [hooks: bo-data-table bo-data-table--sticky-col bo-sticky-w-1 bo-sticky-w-2 data-sticky-cols data-table]
- initTableSum(): Declarative realtime column totals — the auto-sum half of Slice 18's subtotal contract (a deliberate, named exception to "you do the data"; the other half is listening to `bo:cell-change` yourself for… [hooks: bo-data-table__col--numeric data-decimals data-sum-of]
- initTreeTable(): Expand/collapse for hierarchical table rows — document-level delegation, call initTreeTable() once [hooks: bo-data-table bo-tree-table bo-tree-table__toggle data-sum-of data-tree-level data-tree-table]
- initLoadMore(): Load-more pagination ("pull up to see more") — the infinite-scroll alternative to page-number `.bo-pagination` [hooks: bo-btn bo-btn--secondary bo-data-table bo-data-table-container bo-data-table__footer bo-pagination data-load-more-auto data-table-load-more]
- initWindowedList(): Windowed list: server-chunked rows with client-side memory release (roadmap 30.4b) — for SCANNING a large list, not searching one [hooks: bo-app-shell__main bo-btn bo-btn--secondary bo-data-table bo-data-table-container bo-data-table__footer bo-data-table__row-select bo-data-table__spacer bo-density-row-height data-chunk-id data-chunk-offset data-chunk-size data-evicted data-grid-nav data-load-more-auto data-row-id data-selected-count-override data-table data-table-load-more data-table-total-rows data-window-chunks data-windowed data-windowed-selection-host]
- initAnchorNav(): Anchor navigation for long detail screens (the "object page" floorplan) [hooks: bo-anchor-landing-offset bo-app-shell__main bo-motion-duration-slow bo-pagination bo-sidebar-nav bo-sticky-w-1 data-anchor-collapse data-anchor-nav data-state]
- initCollapsibleCards(): Collapsible card sections (.bo-widget) [hooks: bo-widget__collapse data-collapse-trigger data-state]
- initSavedViews(): Saved-view / filter-bar persistence [hooks: bo-filter-bar data-saved-views]
- initWizard(): Multi-step wizard flow — one panel visible at a time, with a bo-stepper kept in sync [hooks: bo-stepper bo-stepper__step data-state data-wizard data-wizard-back data-wizard-current data-wizard-next data-wizard-panel data-wizard-submit]
- initQuantity(): Increment/decrement buttons for .bo-quantity — document-level delegation, call initQuantity() once [hooks: bo-money__currency bo-quantity bo-quantity__input bo-quantity__step bo-quantity__unit-select data-decimals data-quantity-step]
- unitDecimals(): Increment/decrement buttons for .bo-quantity — document-level delegation, call initQuantity() once [hooks: bo-money__currency bo-quantity bo-quantity__input bo-quantity__step bo-quantity__unit-select data-decimals data-quantity-step]
- initMoneyField(): Currency-aware money field — a currency <select> linked to an amount input: changing currency updates the input's `step` (decimal precision) and reformats the current value to that precision [hooks: bo-input bo-input--numeric bo-money bo-money__amount bo-money__currency bo-select data-decimals]
- currencyDecimals(): Currency-aware money field — a currency <select> linked to an amount input: changing currency updates the input's `step` (decimal precision) and reformats the current value to that precision [hooks: bo-input bo-input--numeric bo-money bo-money__amount bo-money__currency bo-select data-decimals]
- initScanInput(): RF/handheld barcode-scanner input [hooks: bo-input bo-input--code bo-visually-hidden data-scan-input data-scan-status data-scan-terminator]
- initFileDropzone(): Drag-and-drop convenience for a `.bo-file-dropzone` [hooks: bo-file-dropzone bo-file-input bo-visually-hidden data-dragover data-file-dropzone]
- initTagInput(): Multi-value tag/chip entry (Fiori Token/MultiInput; Ant/Carbon Tag) — multi-tag cost centers on a record, multiple approval-routing recipients [hooks: bo-alert bo-tag-input bo-tag-input__field bo-tag-input__remove bo-tag-input__tag data-grid]
- initValidationSummary(): Inline validation summary [hooks: bo-alert bo-alert--danger data-validation-summary data-validation-summary-box]
- initTabs(): ARIA tabs behavior via document-level delegation — call initTabs() once [hooks: bo-tabs--vertical bo-tabs__list bo-tabs__tab data-overflow]
- initDropdowns(): Popover-based dropdown menus [hooks: bo-btn bo-btn--secondary bo-checkbox bo-dropdown__item bo-dropdown__menu bo-dropdown__menu--end data-multiselect data-multiselect-count data-multiselect-label]
- initContextMenu(): Right-click (contextmenu) trigger for the SAME popover menu component initDropdowns() already opens on click (roadmap 73.1) [hooks: bo-checkbox bo-dropdown__item bo-dropdown__menu data-col-toggle data-context-menu]
- initCombobox(): Editable combobox with list autocomplete — WAI-ARIA APG combobox pattern (single-select, list autocomplete, manual selection) [hooks: bo-combobox bo-combobox__group bo-combobox__listbox bo-combobox__option bo-combobox__option-label bo-input bo-visually-hidden data-name data-open-on-focus data-value]
- initAlerts(): Dismiss behavior for alerts and toasts: any .bo-alert__dismiss button removes its enclosing .bo-alert [hooks: bo-alert bo-alert__dismiss]
- trapFocus(): Loop Tab / Shift+Tab within a container

## Rules your markup must follow

- State is two-channel: visible non-color cue (glyph, aria-hidden) AND programmatic
  (visually-hidden text like "Completed: ", aria-current, ARIA attributes).
- Forms: aria-invalid + aria-describedby -> message id (+ role="alert" if dynamic).
- Dialogs: aria-labelledby -> title id. Icon-only buttons: aria-label.
- Row-select checkboxes need name/value to POST. Styled lists get role="list".
- Sorting: YOUR code re-orders rows and sets aria-sort on <th>; CSS draws indicator.
- Never user-scalable=no. Never override html font-size (rem-based framework).
- Columns hidden by container compaction (__col--secondary) must stay reachable.
- A scrollable region must be keyboard-reachable: .bo-data-table-container needs
  tabindex="0" (and an aria-label when the table has no caption). axe reports
  scrollable-region-focusable otherwise, and no markup linter can infer it.

## Patterns (task-fit — choose the SHAPE before the components) — https://busy-office.github.io/busy-office-ui/patterns/

### Patterns: enter & find
- Login — https://busy-office.github.io/busy-office-ui/patterns/login/ (complexity 1/4)
  Who uses it: every user, before anything else — the first screen and, for anyone who forgets a password, a recurring one. What "done" looks like: signed in, or told exactly why not without leaking which part was wrong...
  Not for re-authentication mid-task -> https://busy-office.github.io/busy-office-ui/components/dialog/
  uses: form button alerts
- Error pages — https://busy-office.github.io/busy-office-ui/patterns/error-pages/ (complexity 1/4)
  Who uses it: every user, eventually — a stale bookmark, a link shared before a record moved, a permission that changed since yesterday, a request that failed server-side. How often: rare per user, universal per app — ...
  Not for a section failing to load inside a page you're still on -> https://busy-office.github.io/busy-office-ui/components/state-patterns/
  uses: state-patterns button
- App launch — https://busy-office.github.io/busy-office-ui/patterns/app-launch/ (complexity 1/4)
  Who uses it: anyone opening the suite, every session — the first screen after sign-in. What "done" looks like: the right app is one tap away, whether it's a favourite or three deep in a category. A suite entry screen ...
  Not for returning a user to a specific record they already know -> https://busy-office.github.io/busy-office-ui/patterns/object-page/
  uses: /base/primitives dashboard badge
- Role home — https://busy-office.github.io/busy-office-ui/patterns/role-home/ (complexity 2/4)
  Who uses it: every named role — a buyer, an approver, a warehouse supervisor — each seeing their own version. How often: the first screen after sign-in, and the one they come back to between tasks. What "done" looks l...
  Not a launcher -> https://busy-office.github.io/busy-office-ui/patterns/app-launch/
  uses: dashboard progress badge byline button
- Command bar — https://busy-office.github.io/busy-office-ui/patterns/command-bar/ (complexity 1/4)
  Who uses it: power users who know what they want — a dispatcher jumping to PO-88213, a controller running "post period" — without walking the menu. How often: dozens of times a day, which is why it is keyboard-first a...
  Not a replacement for navigation -> https://busy-office.github.io/busy-office-ui/patterns/app-launch/
  uses: dialog combobox kbd button
- List report — https://busy-office.github.io/busy-office-ui/patterns/list-report/ (complexity 2/4)
  Who uses it: AP clerks, all day — the screen they live in. What "done" looks like: find the invoices that need action, act on them in bulk, and never lose your place. Composed entirely from shipped components; the dat...
  Not for a single record's full detail -> https://busy-office.github.io/busy-office-ui/patterns/record-detail/
  uses: data-table pagination filters badge form

  The filter set that outgrew the bar. A finance or purchasing user opens the same list a dozen times a day and narrows it a different way each time — cost centre, status, date range, amount band. They do not want twelv...

- Value help — https://busy-office.github.io/busy-office-ui/patterns/value-help/ (complexity 2/4)
  Who uses it: anyone typing a code they cannot remember — a buyer picking a material out of forty thousand, a clerk choosing a cost centre; dozens of times a day, inside a form they are part-way through. What "done" lo...
  Not when the option set is small -> https://busy-office.github.io/busy-office-ui/components/form/
  uses: dialog filters data-table pagination state-patterns form

  M2 of the four data-maintenance patterns (and the most common one in practice): a list of records, and clicking a row opens that record's fields in a panel beside the list or a dialog over it. A back-office user uses ...
  Not when one record deserves the whole screen -> https://busy-office.github.io/busy-office-ui/patterns/object-page/

- Multi-column detail form — https://busy-office.github.io/busy-office-ui/patterns/detail-form/ (complexity 2/4)

  Not for reading a record -> https://busy-office.github.io/busy-office-ui/patterns/record-detail/

- Job monitor — https://busy-office.github.io/busy-office-ui/patterns/job-monitor/ (complexity 2/4)

- Schedule calendar — https://busy-office.github.io/busy-office-ui/patterns/schedule/ (complexity 2/4)
  A planner or supervisor scans a month for what is booked — deliveries, maintenance windows, shift cover — several times a day during a busy week, and once a day otherwise. "Done" is picking a day and seeing exactly wh...
  Not for authoring a schedule -> https://busy-office.github.io/busy-office-ui/patterns/record-detail/
  uses: calendar dashboard#card data-table badge
- Settings & admin — https://busy-office.github.io/busy-office-ui/patterns/settings-admin/ (complexity 2/4)
  Who uses it: a workspace admin, occasionally a first-time setup wizard. How often: rarely per person, but every workspace has one. What "done" looks like: a section's values saved, or an unsaved change clearly marked ...
  Not for a single end user's own preferences -> https://busy-office.github.io/busy-office-ui/patterns/detail-form/
  uses: form tabs

- RF task queue — https://busy-office.github.io/busy-office-ui/patterns/rf-list/ (complexity 1/4)
  Who uses it: a warehouse floor worker after picking a task from the RF task menu — "what's next" for that task type. What "done" looks like: the worker reads top-to-bottom, taps the top row, and starts working it — no...
  Not for -> https://busy-office.github.io/busy-office-ui/patterns/rf-list#editable-refused/
  uses: data-table badge /concepts/density
- Goods receipt (RF scanner) — https://busy-office.github.io/busy-office-ui/patterns/goods-receipt/ (complexity 3/4)
  Who uses it: a warehouse floor worker, one-handed and often gloved, holding a scanner instead of a mouse. What "done" looks like: every expected line accounted for — received in full, received partial, or explicitly n...
  Not for a desk-based receiving clerk keying a paper packing slip. -> https://busy-office.github.io/busy-office-ui/patterns/detail-form/
  uses: quantity data-table /concepts/density


## Deliberately absent — do not build these, use the alternative

- A grid engine — virtual scroll, column virtualisation, cell editing -> Server-side paging or load-more for lists; the token-themed AG Grid recipe on /concepts/scale for the one screen in twenty that is genuinely a spreadsheet
- An icon catalogue — the hundreds-of-glyphs set -> The 12 shipped ERP glyphs, then --bo-icon-src for anything else: point it at Lucide, Heroicons or your own SVG and .bo-icon supplies sizing, currentColor, density and forced-colors. Measured: 12 glyphs are 10.3% of the framework, so 200 would add ~129 kB — twice everything else we ship
- An illustration / spot-art set -> An <img> you supply with alt=""; for glyphs --bo-icon-src, for a person or org .bo-avatar, for a tenant app tile the launcher's inline svg slot. Empty states are fixed by a clear sentence and the action that resolves them, not by a drawing that must be redrawn per brand and downloaded on a warehouse tablet
- A client-side row virtualiser for SEARCH workflows -> Filter server-side and paginate — fixed row heights are maintained so a third-party virtualiser also drops in cleanly
- Tab overflow arrow buttons -> The edge fade ships and is conditional on actual overflow; add two buttons calling scrollBy if your users expect them
- An app-icon library inside .bo-icon -> Inline <svg> per tenant, or an initials chip — app icons are product content, and every consumer would ship glyphs they never use
- A "field editor" component -> .bo-data-table + data-row-edit + the typed inputs; see /patterns/field-editor
- A master-detail component -> .bo-data-table + a card, dialog or offcanvas; see /patterns/master-detail
- .bo-value-help and .bo-staging-table -> Compose combobox + dialog, and the staging pattern
- A second toolbar idiom -> .bo-cluster already does it

These were considered and declined on purpose; see DESIGN.md and ROADMAP.md for the reasoning.
